name: 050-diarization-multispeaker
description: Four-speaker, 12-turn synthetic conversation with two deliberate overlaps, plus the recorded ground-truth layout. Exists so the DIAR_HOP_RATIO sweep exercises real speaker discrimination instead of collapsing to one cluster. Consumed directly by a Rust test, not by an HTTP endpoint runner.

input_artifacts.notes: Kokoro-82M v1.0 ONNX voice bank, four voices (af_heart, am_michael, bf_emma, bm_george). Turns are laid out by measuring each synthesized utterance, so the ground truth is the actual layout.
Per-turn speaker label, Kokoro voice, start/end in ms, source text, plus the computed overlap intervals.

notes: Synthetic TTS speakers separate far more cleanly than real recordings. A clean sweep here is necessary but not sufficient to move the DIAR_HOP_RATIO default off 0.1.
